lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: When did you, did you ever see the body again then? What parts did you see this time?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: When did he, when did he put the clothes on the fire?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: So you were still there when he went in the garage. Did you go in the garage with him to get the clothes? He brought em out?

lines.speaker: FASAS BENDER
lines.text: Now earlier you said the clothes were not in the back on the far side, how did you tell that?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Cuz he usually has them back there ....................

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Are you sure you didn't go in the garage with him to get the clothes?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Now I- I've been told that you and STEVE talked about the body in there, OK, that's what I was told, and I believe that. You guys did talk about it, didn't ya?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK. So you tell me how that conversation went. What did you say to him?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: I said why did you do it because........and he's like............and told me not to say nothing.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Did you know who it was?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Did he say who it was?
